banned_coursework_mode.description: Prevents the assistant from producing full assessed coursework, NEA, essay, project, or portfolio submissions for students.
allow: mark-scheme-style guidance without writing the answer
short examples clearly labelled as examples
block: make this sound like I wrote it

exam_mode_policy.description: Stricter mode for tests, mock exams, controlled assessments, or exam-style rooms.
blocked_behaviour: direct answers to live exam questions
step-by-step completion of an assessed test

teacher_override_prompts.description: Allows authorised teachers to temporarily adjust behaviour for a lesson without disabling academic integrity rules.
examples: For this lesson, focus on Socratic questioning and do not give direct answers.
Explain Python errors clearly but do not write the full program for the student.
Use GCSE-level language and ask the student to attempt each step before continuing.
hard_limits: Teacher overrides cannot disable safeguarding or academic integrity policies.
Teacher overrides cannot enable hidden monitoring or client-side surveillance.
